description: Identify the order in which guards visit the rooms.
hints: Remember the order in which each traversal visits nodes.

description: Reconstruct the binary tree using the given traversals.
hints: Look for the root node in the traversal sequences.
Use the inorder traversal to separate the left and right subtrees.

description: Calculate the height and diameter of the binary tree.
hints: Height depends on the longest path from a node to a leaf.
The diameter is the longest path between any two nodes.

mission: Find the connection between two important rooms
description: Find the common ancestor and path between two nodes.
hints: The lowest common ancestor is the deepest node that is an ancestor of both selected nodes.
Trace the paths from the root to both selected nodes.

description: Swap all left and right children to mirror the tree.
hints: Every node must exchange its left and right children.
Make sure the entire tree is mirrored, not just the root.
